# AA-Ecosys

> Adventure Asia platform: AA-CIS (content and catalog), AA-TripPlanner-Web (traveller front door) and AA-Booking (customers, trip cases, pricing, payments) on one AWS account (acc2, us-west-1), with Terraform in AA-CIS-Infra. Dev only, test data only; agent rules live in `.claude/CLAUDE.md` and `.kiro/steering/*.md`, which win over every page listed here.

Paths are relative to this `docs/` folder unless they start with a repo name. Read the doc catalog first; open a page only when its description matches the task. Never introspect DB columns from memory: read the generated schema reference.

## Start here

- [Doc catalog](README.md): every maintained doc with ID, path, owner, cadence and status.
- [Agent index](agents.md): which instruction file, steering file and skill wins for what (written in AA-897).
- [Style guide](STYLE.md): one-line AWS CLI with --profile and --region, no literal resource IDs, front-matter, "tested" rule, where a page may live.
- [Glossary](glossary.md): terms with Vietnamese equivalents.
- [Onboarding: accounts and access](onboarding.md): the only account-map table (written in AA-897).

## Architecture

- [Ecosystem architecture](ecosystem-architecture.md): apps, boundaries, identity, data flow.
- [Data standards v1.0](architecture/data-standards/README.md): binding DM-x and C-x rules for the shared RDS.
- [Schema ownership](database/schema-ownership.md): which repo may migrate which schema.
- [Contracts](contracts/README.md): versioned JSON contracts between apps.

## Reference (generated)

- [DB schema reference](architecture/db-schema-reference.md): live dump of every schema, table, column, enum and FK, regenerated by AA-CIS-Infra `db-schema-dump.yml`.

## Operations

- [Incident response](ops/incident-response.md): severities, who to tell, first steps.
- `skill/aa-ship/SKILL.md`: pre-merge checks, deploy gate, live verify, rollback commands.
- `skill/aa-cis-schema/SKILL.md`: DB query pattern (ECS exec S3-mediated), gotchas, destructive-ops DRY RUN.
- [FinOps process](ops/finops.md): tags, budgets, Cost Anomaly Detection, where to read cost; rules are DM-10.
- [Monthly cost report](ops/cost/README.md): how to draft the monthly cost and capacity review (no new Cost Explorer calls).

## Security

- [Security docs index](security/README.md): security pages and access-review records.
- [Security baseline](security/baseline.md): every control with live status, evidence and open issue.
- [Vulnerability management](security/vulnerability-management.md): fix times, exceptions, monthly triage, open alerts.

## Decisions

- [Ecosystem ADR index](adr/README.md): ADR 0001-0008 with amendments; app and Infra ADRs live in their repos.

## Templates

- [Templates](templates/): runbook, how-to, reference, explanation, ADR, postmortem, cost report, release note, UAT report, Definition of Ready, role guide.
- [Front-matter schema](templates/frontmatter.schema.json)

## Optional

- [Live backlog](backlog/README.md): ordered work queue, time-gated checks, decisions waiting on Nghiệp.
- `docs/sessions/`: session logs (Vietnamese, history, not current truth).
- `docs/audits/`: audits and evidence (drills, access and capacity reviews), dated folders.
- `docs/implementation-notes/`: per-issue decisions and trade-offs.
